info.name: Measurabl Core API
Buildings
Returns a paginated list of buildings for a specified portfolio or fund

params.name: portfolio_id
params.description:
UUID of either the parent portfolio or fund
Example: 73755608-a99d-40d9-94df-09d8ff67e7cd

params.name: filter
params.description:
Filter by any attribute available via the endpoint.
  • updatedAt=ge=2022-11-01T00:00 will query for buildings that were updated at or after the set date and UTC time.
  • yearbuilt==1969 will query for buildings that have a year built specifically in 1969.

params.name: size
params.description: The max page size is limited to 200 returned results

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of buildings for a specified portfolio or fund
